missing_data.handling: space_raw and space_score are NULL, health_score is NULL, data_flags bit 0 is set; the logit uses the remaining weights renormalised to the same total

model.formula: p(churn in month m) = logistic(b0 + sum_k w_k * z_k)

standardisation.method: population z-score per sub-item over all non-missing rows, clipped to +/-clip_z, then score = score_mean + score_sd * z clipped to [0, 100]
